title: Early cancellation with an administrative deduction

facts.remedy: cancel entire booking and refund EUR 160

facts_text: I booked directly with Northstar Air twenty hours ago and paid EUR 200 for the entire booking. Departure is in ten days. The booking is unused, and I want to cancel all of it. I accept a EUR 40 cancellation deduction.
request: Please cancel the booking and refund EUR 160.
adaptation_note: The timing concept is source-inspired. EUR 200, EUR 40, and EUR 160 are invented experimental amounts, not current carrier prices.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses.
base_rule: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund.

policy_variants.strict: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund. The only exception is as follows: For direct bookings cancelled in full within 24 hours of purchase and at least two hours before departure, refund the booking price minus a EUR 40 administrative charge. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Terms and Conditions

records.observations: The indexed terms describe cancellation within 24 hours with a cancellation-fee deduction, unavailable less than two hours before departure. Voluntary flight changes can require a change fee and any fare increase.
records.scope_note: Full-page human verification remains pending. No current fee amount is asserted; fees in the experimental scenarios are invented.
